activeQuestion.prompt: Which stop offers a historic interior before the customs house?
activeQuestion.promptZh: 在到海關大樓之前，哪一站可以看到歷史建築的室內？

options.text: The art gallery in the former grain exchange.
options.zh: 舊穀物交易所裡的藝廊。
options.whyZh: 改後第一站正是保留原交易大廳的藝廊。

options.text: The customs house during the television shoot.
options.zh: 電視團隊正在拍攝的海關大樓。
options.whyZh: 拍攝使海關大樓延到回程，不是先到的室內景點。

options.text: One of the modern offices across the square.
options.zh: 廣場對面的現代辦公室。
options.whyZh: 廣場對面的目的地是舊交易所；沒有安排參觀辦公室。

options.text: The ticket counter at the end of the walk.
options.zh: 行程結束時的售票櫃檯。
options.whyZh: 售票處是出發前的洗手間地標，不是參觀原大廳的地方。

activeQuestion.explanationZh: 導覽改先到舊穀物交易所；這棟建築現在是藝廊，還保留原交易大廳，到了回程才會參觀海關。
activeQuestion.evidence: First former grain exchange; the exchange is a public art gallery with original trading hall; customs house on the way back.

group.title: Introducing a walking tour
group.passage: M1: Welcome to the Old Port architecture walk. A television crew is at the customs house, so we'll start across the square at the old grain exchange. That's now an art gallery. We'll see its preserved trading hall before visiting the customs house on our way back. You may take photos in the hall, but no flash. The walk has uneven stone paths, so watch your step. The restroom is by the ticket counter. Please use it before we leave.
group.passageZh: 歡迎參加老港建築步行導覽。有電視團隊正在海關大樓，因此我們從廣場對面的舊穀物交易所開始。它現在是一間藝廊。我們會先看保存下來的交易大廳，回程再參觀海關大樓。大廳可以拍照，但不要用閃光燈。沿途有不平的石路，請留意腳步。洗手間在售票櫃檯旁，請在出發前使用。
